Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 1 by incorrectly hypothesizing that the host of "For One Night Only" was Johnny Carson. The search results returned by the WebSurfer in Step 1 clearly identified "For One Night Only" as an Irish show hosted by Gay Byrne, but the Planner ignored this direct evidence and instead relied on a pre-existing assumption (that the show was hosted by Johnny Carson) to formulate the next set of instructions. This led to a logical disconnect where the subsequent searches were framed around verifying a false premise (Johnny Carson) rather than investigating the actual host (Gay Byrne) revealed in the search results. This error pattern matches the "Premature Assumptions" and "Discrepancy in Evidence and Conclusions" signatures seen in the reference examples, where an agent fails to update its understanding based on new data and continues down an incorrect path.
